quotes.speaker: Grayson Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Grayson Allen on implementing Charlotte Hornets' new practice concepts
quotes.excerpt: pretty good job implementing stuff we've been working on in practice and training camp
quotes.quote: pretty good job implementing stuff we've been working on in practice and training camp. Some really good moments of sharing the ball, effort was there. Obviously we gave up too many points, so cleaning up some of the defensive stuff, rebounding a little bit better, getting better contests, being a little bit more physical on and off the ball.
quotes.social_post: Grayson Allen says the Hornets are focused on cleaning up defensive lapses and rebounding after their latest preseason outing. He noted the team is working on better contests and being more physical on and off the ball.

quotes.speaker: Grayson Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Grayson Allen on the value of preseason game film
quotes.excerpt: it's good to have that, good to review some film this morning
quotes.quote: it's good to have that, good to review some film this morning. It's much different when you're seeing concepts and stuff that you want to do be put into a game in the flow of a live game. So just talking through some of that stuff is good for us going forward.
quotes.social_post: Grayson Allen says reviewing game film is vital for the Hornets right now as they work to translate practice concepts into the flow of a live game.

quotes.speaker: Grayson Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Grayson Allen on his Charlotte Hornets debut
quotes.excerpt: it felt good to put on the Hornets jersey
quotes.quote: solid. We have guys out right now, so much different game, but it felt good to put on the Hornets jersey, that's for sure. I'll say that, and it's nice to get this part of my career going.
quotes.social_post: Grayson Allen describes his Hornets debut as solid and says it feels good to finally get this part of his career going in Charlotte.

quotes.speaker: Grayson Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Grayson Allen on the chemistry of the Charlotte Hornets roster
quotes.excerpt: this is an incredibly close team, top to bottom
quotes.quote: this is an incredibly close team, top to bottom, which is really cool. A lot of guys who are very outspoken. Grant makes you talk, you can't hang around like Grant or Pat or Conn and not talk. Everyone on the team is so close, I feel like I've been here for a while.
quotes.social_post: Grayson Allen is impressed by the chemistry in the Charlotte locker room, noting that the team is incredibly close and that he already feels like he has been here for a while.
